confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cuenca's price levels, not from live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors (meals, coffee, beer) are the more reliable; hotel and hostel anchors and bar drinks are less certain and may vary by season and neighborhood. FX is the RBA 4pm reference for 2026-10-15 as reported in search results and matched by an OFX figure for the same date (0.695572); I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Cuenca's dollarized economy and its position as a mid-sized highland tourist and expat city, benchmarked against other Ecuadorian highland cities and comparable Andean colonial destinations. Prices are set in USD, which Ecuador uses as its currency.
